correctness.rationale: Leibniz on e²=e, f²=f, ev=v=vf yields unique derivations D=(T,w). D^p=0 is exactly T^p=0 and T^{p−1}w=0. Every algebra automorphism is an arrow-basis change G with a vertex-idempotent shear u; its conjugation identifies w modulo TV. In the Jordan module V=⊕(k[t]/t^j)^{c_j}, W=ker(T^{p−1})/TV is the sum of top classes for j<p. The centralizer realizes every permitted triangular block operation, so one zero and one nonzero orbit per occurring j<p. Partition enumeration gives generating series; centralizer order and vector-fibre dimensions give exact F_{m,q}(z) and full derivation rank r or r+1. Small direct characteristic-2 and 3 enumerations independently agree but arbitrary-field classification follows from module proof.
